articles.title: AI Emergency Alerts Are Coming. Humans Might Not Be Ready
articles.descEn: Human beings struggle with emergency communication. Chatbots can help—if people take them seriously.
articles.titleEn: AI Emergency Alerts Are Coming. Humans Might Not Be Ready
summaryLinesEn: A seasoned emergency manager might be able to speed up their communication with the public by having a chatbot draft a series of alerts, but an inexperienced one rushing to create an urgent alert won’t know how to evaluate the output of a model like ChatGPT or Claude.
Emergency managers are the government officials who are in charge of disaster response and recovery.

“If you’ve only sent one [alert] in your life, and that was 15 years ago, and you need to remember all your training, and you’re thinking ‘Hey, there's a chemical plume coming my way, the phone's ringing, the radio's blaring, I need help,’ the AI is probably gonna do a better job than you are,” said Rob Dale, a former meteorologist who now runs the emergency management department in Ingham County, Michigan.

summaryLinesEn: Data Agents takes on a longstanding limit of business intelligence software, where analysts have to build dashboards ahead of time around the questions they expect people to ask.

articles.title: Advisory services reshape accounting education at Intuit - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Advisory services are becoming central to accounting as AI automates routine work, and Intuit Inc. is building a curriculum to prepare students.
articles.titleEn: Advisory services reshape accounting education at Intuit - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Accounting firms spend time retraining new hires, while fewer students are choosing the major out of fear that AI will take the jobs they expected to do, according to David Zasada (pictured), vice president of education and corporate engagement at Intuit.
That shift leaves colleges racing to prepare graduates for a job that looks very different from the one in the textbooks.
“They need to really hit the ground running and provide more value in client advisory services roles, and that is a segment of an accounting firm’s business that’s really on the rise,” Zasada said.

localization.title: Intuit의 회계 교육을 재구성하는 자문 서비스 - SiliconANGLE
summaryLines: Intuit의 교육 및 기업 참여 담당 부사장인 David Zasada(사진)에 따르면 회계 회사는 신입 사원을 재교육하는 데 시간을 소비하는 반면, AI가 예상한 업무를 대신할 것이라는 두려움 때문에 전공을 선택하는 학생이 줄어들고 있다고 함
이러한 변화로 인해 대학은 교과서에 나오는 직업과 매우 다른 직업을 위해 졸업생을 준비시키기 위해 경쟁하게 됨
Zasada는 "그들은 실제로 사업을 시작하고 고객 자문 서비스 역할에 더 많은 가치를 제공해야 하며 이는 실제로 성장하고 있는 회계 회사 비즈니스의 한 부분입니다"라고 말함

articles.title: Should AI Decide Your Court Case? This Judge Says Yes
articles.descEn: One of England’s top judges, Geoffrey Vos, believes that AI could adjudicate plenty of civil cases. The question, he says, is where the line should be drawn.
articles.titleEn: Should AI Decide Your Court Case? This Judge Says Yes
summaryLinesEn: We see a 10 percent rise in the number of county court cases started every year—and it looks as if this may increase.
We moved rapidly into word processors, faxes, and eventually computers.
Multiple lawyers have been caught citing case law hallucinated by AI, and in a first for the UK, somebody recently lost their license to practice in part because they misused the technology.

articles.title: Pairing industrial AI autonomy and human control
articles.descEn: Living digital twins are helping industrial plants run more like living systems, and setting the stage for industries that work in sync.
articles.titleEn: Pairing industrial AI autonomy and human control
summaryLinesEn: For their part, manufacturers are eager for this chapter: In a 2026 Manufacturing Leadership Council survey of manufacturers (opens in new tab) , 66% said they are using or plan to use agentic AI in their operations, and 40% expect some degree of factory autonomy by 2030.
Amid today’s realities of turbulent geopolitics and shifting regulatory demands, such resilience will be “an absolute necessity,” adds McGreevy.

Manufacturers are accelerating toward agentic AI and greater factory autonomy Source: MIT Technology Review Insights with data from Manufacturing Leadership Council (opens in new tab) , 2026 “There is a lot more refinement to be done, a lot more proof points, testing, and validation needed,” McGreevy says about the ongoing process of making AI autonomous.

localization.title: 산업용 AI 자율성과 인간 제어의 결합
summaryLines: 제조업체는 이 장을 열망하고 있음 · 제조업체를 대상으로 한 2026년 제조 리더십 위원회 설문조사(새 탭에서 열림)에서 66%는 운영에 에이전트 AI를 사용 중이거나 사용할 계획이라고 답했으며, 40%는 2030년까지 어느 정도 공장 자율성이 달성될 것으로 기대함
오늘날의 격동적인 지정학적 요구와 변화하는 규제 요구의 현실 속에서 그러한 탄력성은 "절대적으로 필요한 것"이 될 것이라고 McGreevy는 덧붙임

제조업체는 에이전트 AI 및 더 큰 공장 자율성을 향해 가속화하고 있음 · 출처 · 제조 리더십 위원회(Manufacturing Leadership Council)의 데이터가 포함된 MIT Technology Review Insights(새 탭에서 열림), 2026 McGreevy는 AI를 자율화하는 진행 중인 프로세스에 대해 "해야 할 일이 훨씬 더 많고, 훨씬 더 많은 입증 포인트, 테스트 및 검증이 필요함" · 라고 말함

articles.title: Chrome's AI-powered Autofill can now dig through your Gmail to fill out forms
articles.descEn: The autofill update lets Chrome pull flight confirmations, tracking info, order details, and other information from your inbox, with your permission.
articles.titleEn: Chrome's AI-powered Autofill can now dig through your Gmail to fill out forms
summaryLinesEn: On Wednesday, the company said that Chrome will get an advanced version of autofill that will help users fill out online forms with suggestions pulled from their Gmail.

That means Chrome could suggest things you might need to know, like a flight confirmation number, membership ID, tracking information, order number, address, phone number, or credit card number by referencing your email.
As with other Personalized Intelligence features, users can decide whether or not to enable enhanced autofill from their Chrome settings.
articles.summary:

As with other Personalized Intelligence features, users can decide whether or not to enable enhanced autofill from their Chrome settings.

localization.title: 이제 Chrome의 AI 기반 자동완성이 Gmail을 탐색하여 양식을 작성할 수 있음
summaryLines: 수요일에 회사는 Chrome에 사용자가 Gmail에서 가져온 제안 사항을 사용하여 온라인 양식을 작성하는 데 도움이 되는 고급 버전의 자동 완성을 제공할 것이라고 밝힘
즉, Chrome에서는 이메일을 참조하여 항공편 확인 번호, 멤버십 ID, 추적 정보, 주문 번호, 주소, 전화번호, 신용카드 번호 등 귀하가 알아야 할 정보를 제안할 수 있음
다른 개인화된 지능 기능과 마찬가지로 사용자는 Chrome 설정에서 향상된 자동 완성을 활성화할지 여부를 결정할 수 있음

articles.title: Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board
articles.descEn: Just two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon, Google DeepMind is releasing Gemini 4 Carbon, which tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 with 59 points. Google says the model is built for extended agent workflows and the full cyber defense lifecycle. Because of those advanced security capabilities, access is limited to selected security experts at first.
articles.titleEn: Google Deepmind releases Gemini 4 Carbon just two weeks after Argon with gains across the board
summaryLinesEn: Ad On Gray Swan's indirect prompt injection benchmark, Carbon pushed the attack success rate from 0.7 percent with Argon down to 0.0 percent, blocking every tested manipulation attempt according to Google.

Ad The evaluation platform Vals AI puts Carbon in second place at 70.36 percent accuracy, behind Claude Sonnet 5.5 (70.85 percent) and ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 (70.18 percent) and Argon in fourth (69.24 percent), all at lower cost.

Gemini 4 Carbon launches at the same introductory price as Argon: $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with cached input tokens getting a 95 percent discount off the regular input price.

articles.title: Creating AI value with enterprise context
articles.descEn: Across a business, any number of AI platforms, systems, and tools may be at work simultaneously—for example, AI-powered customer platforms, conversational assistants, and workflow and process automation tools. Each one is sophisticated, advanced, and quick to respond. But, when set to work, the outcomes and actions that emerge may be wrong, confused, or lacking a…
articles.titleEn: Creating AI value with enterprise context
summaryLinesEn: Companies are mostly still piloting AI use cases (according to 38% of respondents) or using it to assist employees’ work with tools like co-pilots or chat assistants (35%).
It translates enterprise intelligence into governed, machine-usable context for AI agents or models and helps knowledge compound.

The largest percentage of respondents (40%) say they are seeing moderate gains in specific tasks or teams, while 21% report meaningful gains, leaving 23% that are seeing minimal returns or none at all.

articles.title: Adam Mosseri says negativity around AI is ‘going to get worse’
articles.descEn: Adam Mosseri said in an interview that he expects frustration and anger toward AI to continue getting worse, and not just in creative industries.
articles.titleEn: Adam Mosseri says negativity around AI is ‘going to get worse’
summaryLinesEn: Follow Follow See All AI The Instagram boss said that worries about AI come down to ‘a fear of being left behind in some way.’
They’re concerned about job displacement, having AI displace whatever it is they do, if you’re a content creator or an engineer or a mathematician.
Mosseri said Instagram is “now starting to require AI accounts to label themselves, because we think it’s important that people know if what they’re looking at is real or not real.”

articles.title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
articles.descEn: The frontier lab is lifting the curtain on how users spend money on its models ahead of a planned IPO.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
summaryLinesEn: The company recorded an operating profit in the second quarter, and 900% net revenue retention — that is, spending from the same customers in Q3 2025 grew nine times in Q3 2026.
More importantly, spending on those tools has grown 10x since the beginning of the year, with their cost now equal to about 2% of total engineering cost.
This is a clear attempt to demonstrate the return on investment of Anthropic’s tools and to show customers how to improve it — a major concern among large customers.

articles.descEn: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.
articles.titleEn: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
summaryLinesEn: Alphabet’s Google Services division, which includes Search, generated $96.3 billion in revenue, up 11% year over year.
Google has also surpassed 50 billion visual searches per month.
Google CEO Sundar Pichai also said that Search queries grew at their fastest year-over-year rate in five years, though he did not disclose the exact growth rate.

articles.title: VikingCloud Launches AI Governance Services to Help Brands Find, Assess, and Control Their AI
articles.descEn: Only 4% of large multi-location brands require a corporate security review before locations adopt AI tools, according to recent VikingCloud research. VikingCloud, a cybersecurity and compliance company trusted by 4+ million business locations worldwide, today launched AI Governance Services, a new set of compliance and risk assessments that find the AI tools in use across a business, show where security controls fall short, and deliver a remediation plan to close the gaps.

summaryLinesEn: AI Governance Services extend VikingCloud's assessor practice to AI, bringing the same rigor its global network of assessors has applied to leading brands' security and compliance controls for more than 20 years.

articles.title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system
articles.descEn: In early results from our new life sciences research lab, Claude agents found an enzyme system whose function is still unknown.
articles.titleEn: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system
summaryLinesEn: After 21 hours spent searching this data by roughly 950 agents using 210 million tokens, one of the agents spotted something remarkable: a repeating pattern of DNA sequences that occurs next to the gene for an odd-looking RT.

Our research prior to joining Anthropic has helped to better understand the evolution and regulation of CRISPR systems, discover new enzymes for next-generation cell and gene therapies , and build tools for accelerating the identification of anomalies in DNA, such as human pathogenic variants.
We do research that involves only the lower levels of the biosafety risk level (BSL-1 and BSL-2) and we do not handle pathogens that can infect humans.

localization.title: 클로드가 새로운 효소 시스템을 발견하
summaryLines: 약 950명의 에이전트가 2억 1천만 개의 토큰을 사용하여 이 데이터를 검색한 후 21시간 동안 에이전트 중 한 명이 주목할만한 사실을 발견함 · 이상하게 보이는 RT의 유전자 옆에서 발생하는 DNA 서열의 반복 패턴이었음
Anthropic에 합류하기 전 우리의 연구는 CRISPR 시스템의 진화와 규제를 더 잘 이해하고, 차세대 세포 및 유전자 치료를 위한 새로운 효소를 발견하고, 인간 병원성 변종과 같은 DNA의 변칙적 식별을 가속화하기 위한 도구를 구축하는 데 도움이 됨
우리는 낮은 수준의 생물안전 위험 수준(BSL-1 및 BSL-2)만을 포함하는 연구를 수행하며 인간을 감염시킬 수 있는 병원체는 취급하지 않음

articles.title: Coding agents in the social sciences
articles.descEn: Results from a survey of 1,260 social scientists about AI and coding agent use.
articles.titleEn: Coding agents in the social sciences
summaryLinesEn: But Figure 4 shows that the most common use, for both coding agent users and others, is for coding up analysis of quantitative data: 97% of coding agent users and 77% of other AI users report using it to generate code.
The human sciences are shifting: for the first time, core research tasks can be handed off to machines.
These tools could accelerate science and make it more daring: fast research execution should mean cheap and plentiful discovery.

articles.title: Inside Retail Media on the Top Delivery Platforms
articles.descEn: Read how delivery platforms like instacart, grubhub uber eats and restaurant advertisers approached delivery retail media in 2026.
articles.titleEn: Inside Retail Media on the Top Delivery Platforms
summaryLinesEn: In 2026 YTD, Instacart accounted for nearly half (49%) of all delivery retail media impressions, up from 24% over the same period in 2024.
Retail partnerships expanded the delivery occasion even further, with DoorDash highlighting Urban Outfitters delivery and Instacart promoting access to Lowe’s.
CPG brands often positioned delivery as an easy solution for everyday and last-minute needs, like having Tums delivered by Uber Eats.

articles.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt
articles.descEn: A Blog post by NVIDIA on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt
summaryLinesEn: NVIDIA models hold the top two spots on David AI’s multilingual diarization leaderboard : Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe posts the lowest overall diarization error rate (DER), 18.26% across 21 languages, followed by Nemotron 3 Diarization at 18.38%.

Granary v2’s multilingual data (available on Hugging Face and ModelScope ) and reusable curation pipeline, together with NeMo Speech fine-tuning tools , extend prompt-level control to training: developers can define the written form they need and adapt the model to the speech their applications encounter.
On AA-AgentTalk, the held-out voice-agent speech set that makes up 50% of the AA-WER index, Transcribe scores 1.8% WER, versus 2.3% for the next-best open-weight model.

summaryLinesEn: That same real-time decision making lets a voice agent switch languages, hand a caller to a person at the right moment, or give your most valuable customers the experience they expect.
People who moved from storefronts to websites to apps now expect to simply talk to the companies they buy from, and the same shift is reaching suppliers, drivers, and field teams.
Three other drivers are already on hold, and every minute he waits puts the next delivery at risk.

articles.title: Accelerating software delivery with agentic QA automation using Amazon Nova Act – Part 3 | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: As QA test automation spreads across an organization, organizing tests and controlling who owns them becomes the real work. Part 3 of the QA Studio series on Amazon Nova Act adds applications that organize tests and report health metrics, plus team-based user management that controls who can see and change what.
articles.titleEn: Accelerating software delivery with agentic QA automation using Amazon Nova Act – Part 3 | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: As quality assurance (QA) automation adoption grows inside an organization, a new problem appears that has nothing to do with writing tests.
In the first post , we introduced QA Studio, a reference solution built with Amazon Nova Act .
Because roles are cumulative, a Team Lead has everything an Editor has, and so on down to Viewer.

articles.title: Distributed training with Ray Train DLCs and EFA on EKS | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: The Ray Train Deep Learning Container ships the full CUDA-through-EFA stack, so you build no image. This post walks through a reproducible sample that fine-tunes Qwen2.5-1.5B with PyTorch FSDP across eight GPUs on two EFA-enabled g6.12xlarge instances on Amazon EKS, using the container exactly as published.
articles.titleEn: Distributed training with Ray Train DLCs and EFA on EKS | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Budget: about $9.50 an hour while the GPU instances are up, covering both instances, the EKS control plane and the NAT Gateway.
Qwen2.5-1.5B in bfloat16 needs about 12 GB for those four tensors.
Building that image and rebuilding it each time one of those pieces moves is a project of its own, and it has nothing to do with the model you set out to train.

articles.title: Adapt your ad strategy to meet the way people search today.
articles.descEn: Google's Ads Decoded podcast tells you how to make smarter marketing decisions using the latest data on how consumers search.
articles.titleEn: Adapt your ad strategy to meet the way people search today.
summaryLinesEn: In this episode of Ads Decoded, Google Ads Product Liaison Ginny Marvin sits down with Shivani Mohan, Vice President of Data Science and UXR for Search.
Shivani and her teams study how billions of users are searching and explore how user habits are shifting with the introduction of AI Overviews and AI Mode.
Tune in for behind-the-scenes insights into her team's research, the modern search experience, and what long-form query trends mean for businesses today.

articles.title: AI for Science expands to foundations and institutions
articles.descEn: We’re highlighting 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups from around the world that we’ve partnered with in an expansion of our AI for Science program.
articles.titleEn: AI for Science expands to foundations and institutions
summaryLinesEn: We started the AI for Science program in May 2025 with the belief that AI could significantly speed up scientific progress.

(Over the last few months, we’ve also launched our discounted Team plan for scientists and have supported hundreds of projects across biology, medicine, physics, chemistry, climate science, and mathematics.)

This $9 billion federal agency established by Congress in 1950 promotes the progress of science, advances national health and defense, and funds competitive research and education, accounting for about 25% of federal support for basic research at US colleges and universities.

articles.title: Changing course: How Drive the Future helped students find their own path to success
articles.descEn: Discover how Arm’s Drive the Future 2026 event inspired students to explore AI and STEM careers through hands-on learning and mentorship.
articles.titleEn: Changing course: How Drive the Future helped students find their own path to success
summaryLinesEn: Drive the Future brought that commitment to life by connecting real-world applications of AI and advanced computing with perspectives from industry professionals who have faced their share of challenges.

Building on last year’s Drive the Future event , Arm, Aston Martin Aramco Formula One® Team, and Texas State Technical College expanded this year’s program to give students hands-on engineering experience, access to industry role models, and a clearer view of the many pathways into STEM.
“We’re going to need to continue to innovate forward into the future with new technologies and, of course, many brilliant minds.

articles.title: CIO Executive Council Resources
articles.titleEn: CIO Executive Council Resources
summaryLinesEn: This IDC Survey Spotlight, prepared by Gina Smith , PhD, Senior Research Director, IT Skills for Digital Business, examines data from IDC’s 2026 Future Enterprise Resiliency and Spending Survey to explore how organizations are grappling with IT skills validation across four key regions: North America, Asia Pacific, Western Europe, and the Middle East and North Africa.
As AI becomes integral to enterprise operations, CIOs are shifting focus from rapid deployment to engineering sustainable AI economics.

The survey highlights that leadership perspectives on modernization priorities, business drivers, obstacles, IT budget allocation, decision criteria, data architecture maturity, data quality, and the data-related initiatives organizations are prioritizing to enable AI use cases over the next 12–18 months.

localization.title: CIO 집행위원회 리소스
summaryLines: 디지털 비즈니스를 위한 IT 기술 수석 연구 이사인 Gina Smith 박사가 준비한 이 IDC 설문 조사 스포트라이트는 IDC의 2026년 미래 기업 탄력성 및 지출 설문 조사의 데이터를 검토하여 조직이 북미, 아시아 태평양, 서유럽, 중동 및 북아프리카의 4개 주요 지역에서 IT 기술 검증과 어떻게 씨름하고 있는지 살펴봄
AI가 기업 운영에 필수적인 요소가 되면서 CIO는 신속한 배포에서 지속 가능한 AI 경제성 엔지니어링으로 초점을 옮기고 있음
설문조사에서는 조직이 향후 12~18개월 동안 AI 사용 사례를 활성화하기 위해 우선순위를 정하는 현대화 우선 순위, 비즈니스 동인, 장애물, IT 예산 할당, 결정 기준, 데이터 아키텍처 성숙도, 데이터 품질 및 데이터 관련 이니셔티브에 대한 리더십 관점을 강조함

우리는 수많은 기업이 ROI와 실질적인 결과를 달성하도록 도왔으며 이는 강력한 비즈니스 기술 제휴로 귀결됨 · 경영진의 42%가 생성 AI로 인해 기업 권력 투쟁과 혼란을 경험하고 있음 · 41%는 IT 리더가 직원과 효과적으로 협업하지 않는다고 느꼈고, 36%는 다른 사업부와의 협업이 부족하다고 느꼈음
WRITER는 IT 및 비즈니스 사용자를 지원하는 풀 스택 플랫폼을 제공하여 Commvault, Salesforce, Curology 및 Sprout Social과 같은 회사가 전략적이고 조율된 AI 채택을 달성하는 데 도움이 되는 노코드 플랫폼과 포괄적인 교육을 제공함

articles.title: AI agents are changing what CPU performance means
articles.descEn: Discover how AI agents are reshaping CPU performance, placing greater importance on orchestration, memory, I/O, and sustained system efficiency.
articles.titleEn: AI agents are changing what CPU performance means
summaryLinesEn: On OpenRouter, agent token usage has increased roughly 14x since February 2026, according to data highlighted by a16z .

Nearly 2x more work per rack: Arm AGI CPU delivers an average of 1.99x modeled performance per rack compared with AMD EPYC 9755 across seven workloads, driven by higher compute density and power efficiency.

Strong performance across agentic workloads: Arm AGI CPU delivers higher modeled rack-level performance across key agentic workloads, averaging 1.7x for tooling, 2.0x for agentic workflows and orchestration, and 2.2x for reasoning and planning, demonstrating its ability to support the diverse compute demands of agentic AI.

localization.title: AI 에이전트가 CPU 성능의 의미를 바꾸고 있음
summaryLines: a16z에서 강조한 데이터에 따르면 OpenRouter에서 에이전트 토큰 사용량은 2026년 2월 이후 약 14배 증가함
랙당 거의 2배 더 많은 작업 · Arm AGI CPU는 더 높은 컴퓨팅 밀도와 전력 효율성을 통해 7가지 워크로드에서 AMD EPYC 9755에 비해 랙당 평균 1.99배의 모델링 성능을 제공함
에이전트 워크로드 전반에 걸쳐 강력한 성능 · Arm AGI CPU는 주요 에이전트 워크로드 전반에 걸쳐 더 높은 모델링된 랙 수준 성능을 제공하며, 툴링의 경우 평균 1.7배, 에이전트 워크플로 및 오케스트레이션의 경우 2.0x, 추론 및 계획의 경우 2.2배를 제공하여 에이전트 AI의 다양한 컴퓨팅 요구를 지원하는 능력을 입증함

articles.title: Arm AGI CPU is coming to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
articles.descEn: The planned offering builds on OCI’s adoption of Arm-based compute portfolio to support the growing demands of general-purpose cloud workloads and agentic AI
articles.titleEn: Arm AGI CPU is coming to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
summaryLinesEn: OCI’s investment in Arm already spans Oracle Linux, Java, MySQL and widely used cloud-native tools, giving developers a familiar ecosystem as their compute options grow.
“Arm-based compute is an important part of how we deliver performance, efficiency and choice to OCI customers,” said Mahesh Thiagarajan, President, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
At Oracle AI World, Oracle outlined plans to bring Arm AGI CPU to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) in fall 2027.
articles.summary:
OCI’s investment in Arm already spans Oracle Linux, Java, MySQL and widely used cloud-native tools, giving developers a familiar ecosystem as their compute options grow.
“Arm-based compute is an important part of how we deliver performance, efficiency and choice to OCI customers,” said Mahesh Thiagarajan, President, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
At Oracle AI World, Oracle outlined plans to bring Arm AGI CPU to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) in fall 2027.

articles.title: HONOR Announces Global Availability of HONOR 10X Lite and Partnerships to Spur Creativity and Innovation
articles.descEn: HONOR join forces with Wattpad, the global multi-platform entertainment company and world’s leading social storytelling platform, to empower writers to share their stories and aspirations.
articles.titleEn: HONOR Announces Global Availability of HONOR 10X Lite and Partnerships to Spur Creativity and Innovation
summaryLinesEn: [10 November 2020] – Global technology brand HONOR today announced the global availability of the HONOR 10X Lite and a line-up of partnerships that leverages HONOR’s core competencies to encourage creativity and innovation among users.
HONOR recently launched the HONOR Academy ‘Stand Out With HONOR’ global creative program.
The HONOR 10X Lite features a stunning quad-camera set up, a 6.67” punch-hole display and a whopping 5000mAh battery, to help users live life to the max.

articles.title: HONOR Achieves ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Certification | HONOR Official Site (Global)
articles.descEn: The British Standards Institute (BSI) presented the ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Certification to HONOR.
articles.titleEn: HONOR Achieves ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Certification | HONOR Official Site (Global)
summaryLinesEn: HONOR’s e-commerce system, sales and customer services, Magic UI, cloud service business, internal information security management system, and IT services, are all certified by this standard as well.

By showcasing its capability in integrating internal resources and establishing an efficient information security management system, HONOR was able to achieve the international certification from BSI in a short period of time.
Keeping up with the rapid growth of the company while ensuring the information security risks controllable is an important mission for HONOR.

articles.title: HONOR Band 6 Launches with Bigger Display and Premium Health Monitoring Features
articles.descEn: Innovative fitness band, HONOR band 6, offers a holistic range of health and fitness tracking capabilities to empower people to stay mentally and physically fit.
articles.titleEn: HONOR Band 6 Launches with Bigger Display and Premium Health Monitoring Features
summaryLinesEn: Providing a clear and comfortable viewing experience on your wrist, the HONOR Band 6 boasts a large and vivid 1.47-inch AMOLED display with a resolution of 194 x 368, offering a 148% increase in display area when compared to its predecessor.

Equipped with up to 50 meters of water resistance, the HONOR Band 6 is ideal for swimmers for its capability of tracking activity under water, such as your SWOLF score and swimming stroke rates, helping users to boost their swimming efficiency.

Equipped with a stunning 1.47-inch AMOLED display and packed full of health and fitness management functions with an outstanding 14-day battery life, the HONOR Band 6 is the perfect fusion of innovative style and exquisite technology, allowing users to keep better tabs on their mental and physical wellbeing.

articles.title: MacPaw Launches 'Eney' AI Assistant for Mac and iPhone
articles.descEn: MacPaw has launched Eney, a proactive AI assistant for Mac and iPhone that the company says understands what is happening across a user's apps, files, and system, prepares the next step, and asks before it acts.
articles.titleEn: MacPaw Launches 'Eney' AI Assistant for Mac and iPhone
summaryLinesEn: A Starter plan with 10,000 AI credits costs $14.99/month, a Boost plan with 25,000 credits costs $29.99/month, and a Power plan with 50,000 credits costs $49.99/month.
Eney for Mac is available to download from eney.ai and requires an Apple silicon Mac running macOS 15 or later.

The app also surfaces Mac care warnings for low disk space, memory pressure, and crashing apps, and connects to Apple Mail, Calendar, and Reminders out of the box, plus Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Slack, Notion, Jira, and Linear.

articles.title: Vertiv stock surges as orders double amid AI build-out: 'Evolving faster than ever'
articles.descEn: Vertiv continues to benefit from the massive capex spending from the likes of Google and Microsoft.
articles.titleEn: Vertiv stock surges as orders double amid AI build-out: 'Evolving faster than ever'
summaryLinesEn: In the third quarter, Vertiv reported net sales of $4.31 billion, beating Wall Street's expectations of $3.76 billion.
"We are in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout and it's accelerating," Vertiv's CEO Giordano Albertazzi stated in the company's earnings release .
Vertiv ( VRT ) stock surged 13% as the data center infrastructure player showed it continues to benefit from the massive spending from the likes of Google ( GOOG ) and Microsoft ( MSFT ).

articles.title: Home Depot wants your AI agent to show some ID first
articles.descEn: Home Depot's chief information officer told Business Insider the retailer needs AI agents to self-identity and verify they're acting on your behalf.
articles.titleEn: Home Depot wants your AI agent to show some ID first
summaryLinesEn: She said the company was not granted access in the project's first wave, "despite our best efforts, and calling a lot of friends."
Recently, several Silicon Valley companies have launched consumer-focused AI agents, such as Meta's Muse and Spear Street Technology's Instinct AI.

During a sit-down interview with Business Insider, Angie Brown, the company's executive vice president and chief information officer, said the retailer wants to support AI agents that can search and buy products on a customer's behalf.

articles.title: Building an Agentic AI Platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Stand up a governed, multi-account Agentic AI Platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. This post walks through the architecture and an open-source reference blueprint: the operating model, control plane, per-Workstream cells, separate inference and tool gateways, and a CI/CD evaluation pipeline that gates each agent before production.
articles.titleEn: Building an Agentic AI Platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The gateway applies the organization’s guardrails (for example, Amazon Bedrock Guardrails or a third-party provider), restricts which models and inference AWS Regions each Workstream can use, and enforces per-Workstream rate limits, token quotas, and budgets so that no single team can exhaust shared capacity.
Release: The previous agent runtime version can be restored.

The Enterprise Agentic AI Platform Blueprint , built on AgentCore, adds the surrounding enterprise contracts as deployable infrastructure as code: ownership, account boundaries, software delivery, observability, cost governance, and retirement.

articles.title: Apple rolls out iOS 27.2 with new Siri AI languages and security fixes
articles.descEn: The latest Apple software update for iPhones and iPads includes new features and important security updates.
articles.titleEn: Apple rolls out iOS 27.2 with new Siri AI languages and security fixes
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell Julie Bort Warhound raises $200M to engineer war dogs and arm them with Anduril gear Dominic-Madori Davis Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work Lucas Ropek Airbnb limits chores for guests, sparking backlash from hosts Lauren Forristal

Apple has rolled out its latest iOS 27.2 update for iPhones and iPads, featuring expanded language support and improved memory functions for Siri AI, suggestions in messages, and Apple Pencil support for the foldable iPhone Duo.

Apple has also added Multiview to iPhone so viewers can watch up to four live sport streams simultaneously on Apple TV such as Major League Soccer (MLS), Formula 1 (F1) in the U.S., and Friday Night Baseball doubleheaders during the Major League Baseball (MLB) season.

summaryLines: Nvidia CEO는 사랑스러운 Microduck 로봇을 가지고 놀고, 20,000개 판매 Julie Bort Warhound는 군견을 설계하고 Anduril 장비로 무장하기 위해 2억 달러를 모금함 · Dominic-Madori Davis Uber는 30,000명의 직원 모두 ChatGPT 작업에 투입함 · Lucas Ropek Airbnb는 손님의 집안일을 제한하여 호스트 Lauren Forristal의 반발을 불러일으켰음

articles.descEn: Meta on Monday announced plans to raise a total of $95 billion to support its investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure.
articles.titleEn: Nvidia, AMD to invest $4 billion in Meta as tech giants deepen AI partnership
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia and AMD have said they will invest $3 billion and $1 billion, respectively, in Meta.

Nvidia announced its investment on Tuesday, adding that Meta would expand Vera Rubin and Vera CPU deployment, and that the two companies would deepen their partnership on Muse, the social media giant's AI agent that launched last month.
Meta on Monday announced plans to raise a total of $95 billion to support its investments in artificial intelligence infrastructure.

articles.title: I Tried to Fool a Scientific Publisher With AI
articles.descEn: My experiment with an IEEE journal revealed AI’s threats to scholarly publishing
articles.titleEn: I Tried to Fool a Scientific Publisher With AI
summaryLinesEn: By 2025, an estimated 57 percent of all published academic articles exhibited detectable evidence of large language model (LLM) influence, a massive jump from 12 percent in 2023.
Of course, evidence of AI use doesn’t necessarily mean a paper is slop.
Given that for every 40 papers showing statistical evidence of AI usage in 2025, only one formally disclosed it , these figures likely grossly underestimate LLM involvement today.

summaryLines: 2025년에는 출판된 모든 학술 논문의 약 57%가 LLM(대형 언어 모델) 영향에 대한 탐지 가능한 증거를 나타냈으며, 이는 2023년의 12%에서 크게 증가한 수치임
물론 AI 사용의 증거가 반드시 논문이 엉성하다는 것을 의미하는 것은 아님
2025년 AI 사용에 대한 통계적 증거를 보여주는 논문 40개 중 단 한 건만이 이를 공식적으로 공개했다는 점을 고려하면, 이 수치는 오늘날 LLM 참여를 크게 과소평가할 가능성이 높음

articles.title: VisionQuest is what happens when AI really goes rogue
articles.descEn: Each episode of VisionQuest has felt like a reminder of the AI industry’s obsession with science fiction.
articles.titleEn: VisionQuest is what happens when AI really goes rogue
summaryLinesEn: VisionQuest picks up some time after Agatha All Along and follows synthezoid Vision (Paul Bettany) on a journey of self-discovery.
Even though the multicolored MacGuffins haven’t been featured in VisionQuest , they’re important because of the role one of them played in Vision’s origins.

VisionQuest reinforces the idea that the Mind Stone was a key element in Vision’s becoming something more than an elaborate machine, giving him the capacity to independently form meaningful relationships and make sense of the world around him the way a person can.

articles.title: Oracle, in effort to reduce reliance on Nvidia, adds AI chips from Google, Cerebras, and SambaNova
articles.descEn: Oracle is bringing AI chips from Google, Cerebras, SambaNova to its cloud as the company diversifies beyond Nvidia.
articles.titleEn: Oracle, in effort to reduce reliance on Nvidia, adds AI chips from Google, Cerebras, and SambaNova
summaryLinesEn: Cerebras's massive chips will provide AI inference capacity and AI agent processing power, while SambaNova's SN50 processor will handle agentic inference.
Oracle said its decision to bring on Google, Cerebras, and SambaNova's processors provides its customers with the right infrastructure for their particular needs.
Nvidia has previously said it generates roughly half of its revenue from hyperscalers, making Google's move and Amazon's potential efforts of particular concern for the company.

articles.title: AI Agents Are Media’s New Favorite Audience
articles.descEn: As agents go mainstream, some publishers are hoping that people will pay for content tailor-made for AI—not humans.
articles.titleEn: AI Agents Are Media’s New Favorite Audience
summaryLinesEn: The six-year-old tech media and software company, which announced a $2 million funding round from investors including LinkedIn founder Reid Hoffman last year, expects its subscribers to treat AI as almost an extension of themselves.
What Axios and a handful of others are trying, though, represents a more foundational shift in how the media operates—and who its stories are for.
Last year, AIOSEO , a SEO plug-in for WordPress sites, launched a feature that provides websites with LLM.txt files, which help AI discover and interpret sites’ content.

localization.title: AI 에이전트는 미디어가 가장 선호하는 새로운 잠재고객임
summaryLines: 작년에 LinkedIn 설립자 Reid Hoffman을 포함한 투자자들로부터 200만 달러의 자금 조달 라운드를 발표한 6년 역사의 기술 미디어 및 소프트웨어 회사인 이 회사는 가입자들이 AI를 거의 자신의 확장으로 간주할 것으로 기대함
그러나 Axios와 소수의 다른 사람들이 시도하고 있는 것은 미디어가 운영되는 방식과 그 이야기의 대상이 누구인지에 대한 보다 근본적인 변화를 나타냄
작년에 WordPress 사이트용 SEO 플러그인인 AIOSEO는 AI가 사이트의 콘텐츠를 발견하고 해석하는 데 도움이 되는 LLM.txt 파일을 웹사이트에 제공하는 기능을 출시함

articles.descEn: You can use the AI assistant to update calendar events and search your inbox, among other things.
articles.titleEn: ChatGPT can work with your iCloud Mail and Calendar thanks to new plugin support - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Ask ChatGPT to find that email, catch up on your inbox, check what's next, or update a calendar event.

articles.title: Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
articles.descEn: The new standard, WebAI, is designed to work with a variety of AI models.
articles.titleEn: Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
summaryLinesEn: WebAI grew out of previous work by Opera to bring locally run models into its browsers.
Browser maker Opera has introduced a new web standard that lets users to run AI models directly in its browser, without relying on the cloud.
“Users don’t need AI subscriptions, the information the local AI handles stays on their own device, and they stay in control of the AI on their computer.”

articles.title: Apple is adding an AI chatbot to Pages, Keynote, and Numbers
articles.descEn: Apple is bringing an AI assistant to its Pages, Keynote, and Numbers apps, which can understand the context of a document to perform tasks.
articles.titleEn: Apple is adding an AI chatbot to Pages, Keynote, and Numbers
summaryLinesEn: Meanwhile, Logic Pro for Mac and iPad is getting a Liquid Glass redesign, along with an AI assistant that Apple says can “set up a vocal track from a single prompt” and edit existing projects.
Keynote, Pages, and Numbers now support the Model Context Protocol on macOS 27 or later, allowing third-party AI agents to plug into the apps.
Apple is bringing an AI assistant to its suite of productivity apps , including Keynote, Pages, and Numbers.

articles.title: Apple's iMac with M6 arrives promising a 'huge leap' in AI performance - Engadget
articles.descEn: It offers more cores and more performance per core than the iMac M4.
articles.titleEn: Apple's iMac with M6 arrives promising a 'huge leap' in AI performance - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Since it's mainly designed for productivity, Apple says the iMac is up to 50 percent faster for tasks like Microsoft Excel compared to the iMac M4, or 2.5x faster than the M1 model.

That processor, along with faster 170GB/s memory bandwidth, will make the iMac twice as fast for graphics performance compared to the previous iMac M4 model, accelerating intensive tasks like photo editing and gaming, Apple said.
Unlike the latest Mac Studio, it only supports Thunderbolt 4 rather than the two-times-faster Thunderbolt 5 connections, unfortunately.

summaryLinesEn: Stormbreaker Ventures led the round, bringing the company’s total funding to $9 million.

articles.title: Cisco Partner Summit: Five insights that will define the channel in the AI era - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Cisco Partner Summit: Five insights that will define the channel in the AI era - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: Cisco Partner Summit: Five insights that will define the channel in the AI era - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Tim Coogan (pictured), senior vice president of global partner sales, told the 2,000 partners in attendance that channel bookings accounted for about 90% of Cisco’s total in fiscal 2026 and that global channel growth was just over 17%.
The 2026 Partner Summit marks the Cisco channel’s shift from a resale model to an intelligence-led services model.

Cisco is backing that with a $2,500 adoption incentive per onboarded customer, a 6% deal registration on Standard and Signature support, and a $1 million Builders Challenge for partners who create managed services on Cisco IQ.

articles.title: Cybersecurity in the AI era: Why cyber resilience matters - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Cybersecurity faces a new era as AI speeds vulnerability discovery for defenders and attackers alike, making cyber resilience essential.
articles.titleEn: Cybersecurity in the AI era: Why cyber resilience matters - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: AI models have dramatically increased the ability to analyze and potentially exploit weaknesses.

A prime example of how AI models have shifted cybersecurity into a new gear can be seen in recent news involving exploits surrounding the PHP programming language, which powers up to 70% of global websites.
This has placed even greater emphasis on the need for recovery and resilience, according to InfoScale Director of Product Management Joseph D’Angelo .

articles.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra for faster, better performing AI agents at half the price - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra for faster, better performing AI agents at half the price - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Terra for faster, better performing AI agents at half the price - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: On the Terminal-Bench 4.0 test, which measures coding agents on tasks done through a computer’s command-line terminal, it solved 50.3% of all tasks when using maximum reasoning effort, up from 21.5% with GPT-5.6 Terra.
The new model is the successor to GTP-5.6 Terra and is said to cost around 50% less while handling computer use tasks faster and with greater accuracy.

GPT-6.1 Terra understands what’s on screen, takes action across apps, writes naturally, and is a more capable model for your whole workday with the efficiency to take on more of it. pic.twitter.com/8JTN1yonmV OpenAI said the model is available now for all ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex.

localization.title: OpenAI, 절반 가격으로 더 빠르고 더 나은 성능의 AI 에이전트를 위한 GPT-6.1 Terra 출시 - SiliconANGLE
summaryLines: 컴퓨터의 명령줄 터미널을 통해 수행되는 작업에 대한 코딩 에이전트를 측정하는 Terminal-Bench 4.0 테스트에서 최대 추론 노력을 사용할 때 모든 작업의 50.3%를 해결했으며 이는 GPT-5.6 Terra의 21.5%에서 증가한 것임
새로운 모델은 GTP-5.6 Terra의 후속 모델로 컴퓨터 사용 작업을 더 빠르고 정확하게 처리하면서 비용은 약 50% 저렴하다고 함

GPT-6.1 Terra는 화면에 표시된 내용을 이해하고, 여러 앱에서 작업을 수행하고, 자연스럽게 글을 쓰며, 더 많은 작업을 수행할 수 있는 효율성을 갖춘 전체 업무 시간에 더 유능한 모델임 · pic.twitter.com/8JTN1yonmV OpenAI는 이제 ChatGPT Work 및 Codex의 모든 ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Enterprise 및 Edu 사용자가 이 모델을 사용할 수 있다고 말함

articles.title: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees amid AI investments - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees amid AI investments - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees amid AI investments - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: After the company let go 1,600 of the division’s employees in June, GeekWire reported that additional layoffs were expected.
Microsoft will also provide stock vesting for six to 12 months, continued healthcare coverage for a limited amount of time and outplacement support.
Microsoft’s revenue grew 18% year-over-year in the three months ended June, to $90.01 billion, while its adjusted earnings of $4.74 per share topped the consensus estimate by more than 12%.
articles.summary:
After the company let go 1,600 of the division’s employees in June, GeekWire reported that additional layoffs were expected.
Microsoft will also provide stock vesting for six to 12 months, continued healthcare coverage for a limited amount of time and outplacement support.
Microsoft’s revenue grew 18% year-over-year in the three months ended June, to $90.01 billion, while its adjusted earnings of $4.74 per share topped the consensus estimate by more than 12%.

articles.titleEn: Apple Creator Studio update adds MotionVFX to Final Cut, and AI to everywhere - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Apple Creator Studio costs $13 per month or $129 per year, and any new subscriber can try it out first with a one-month free trial.

There are plenty of other smaller quality-of-life additions for creators, like additional keyframe easing options in Final Cut Pro and the ability to isolate or swap out drum parts with the Stem Splitter in Logic Pro.
Some Final Cut Pro features require Apple silicon to work, and any Mac running the Apple Creator Studio version of the program needs to be running on macOS 26.6 or later.

After Apple, Google, Microsoft and Mozilla came together to deprecate the standard in 2020 , less than an estimated 25 percent of all websites support TSL 1.0 connections as of mid last year, meaning the 6300 essentially can't access the modern internet.

Over on the server side, Aikon will hold messages for up to 30 days, and the app supports English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Russian, Indonesian and Turkish.

articles.title: Exclusive: Meta director Rohit Patel departs after 8 years to take on Microsoft Office Suite
articles.descEn: Rohit Patel is departing Meta after eight years working on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. His startup, Ndoc, aims to take on Microsoft Office Suite.
articles.titleEn: Exclusive: Meta director Rohit Patel departs after 8 years to take on Microsoft Office Suite
summaryLinesEn: His desire to open-source this project was partly why he left Meta and decided to go it alone.
The former director at Meta Superintelligence Labs has launched Ndoc , a startup he’s pitching as an AI-native replacement for Microsoft Office suite or Google Workspace.
At a big company like Meta, getting everyone to agree on an open source format would undoubtedly require the input of “hundreds of people and opinions on how the format should look.”

articles.title: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?
articles.descEn: TechCrunch spoke to the MIT computer scientist charged with explaining OpenAI's latest mind-bending discovery.
articles.titleEn: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?
summaryLinesEn: The claims from OpenAI and Anthropic is that their models have come up with algorithms that solve those puzzles in “sub-exponential” time, meaning faster than the speeds previously thought possible.

The durability of ETH has lead to it being included in many scientific papers over the past decade that will need to be revisited if the AI labs claims that they’ve proven it wrong holds up, Williams said.
One was a surprise rejection of the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH), a durable assumption in computer science that plays a large role in how we understand what is difficult to compute.

summaryLines: OpenAI와 Anthropic의 주장은 그들의 모델이 이전에 가능하다고 생각했던 속도보다 빠른 "하지수" 시간에 이러한 퍼즐을 해결하는 알고리즘을 제시했다는 것임
Williams는 ETH의 내구성으로 인해 지난 10년 동안 많은 과학 논문에 포함되어 AI 연구소가 ETH가 틀렸다는 것을 입증했다고 주장할 경우 재검토가 필요할 것이라고 말함
그 중 하나는 계산하기 어려운 것을 이해하는 데 큰 역할을 하는 컴퓨터 과학의 지속적인 가정인 지수 시간 가설(ETH)을 놀랍게도 거부한 것임

articles.title: OpenAI asks outside experts, including a Nobel laureate, to check proofs its AI produced in math, computer science, and physics
articles.descEn: OpenAI says its internal AI models have cracked three major open questions in math, computer science, and physics. One of them is part of a famous Millennium Prize Problem, each of which carries a $1 million prize. Outside experts, including a Nobel laureate, are now checking whether the proofs hold up. If the computer science proof holds on its own, hundreds of research papers lose their foundation.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI asks outside experts, including a Nobel laureate, to check proofs its AI produced in math, computer science, and physics
summaryLinesEn: Outside experts will now decide whether the proofs hold up.
OpenAI calls the manuscripts a kind of raw research data that still needs to be understood.
At the current pace, he said, it's plausible that practical SAT solving could see serious progress within 12 months.

articles.title: Former Deepmind researcher thinks AlphaGo's playbook can cure AI hallucinations
articles.descEn: Former Deepmind researcher Thore Graepel wants his startup Metis Reasoning to bring AlphaGo's search principle to general reasoning. Instead of locking knowledge inside model weights, an explicit knowledge ledger would make every conclusion checkable against evidence. So far, though, there's no working system and no benchmarks.

summaryLinesEn: Tim Rocktäschel co-founded Recursive , now valued at $4.65 billion.
He then moved to Deepmind, where he worked on AlphaGo , AlphaZero , and MuZero .

Hallucinations come from the training process itself , the paper argues, because models learn to produce plausible text rather than true text, and even the chains of thought in today's reasoning models often fail to show how an answer was actually reached.

articles.title: Firefox’s Smart Window adds AI form filling and webpage monitoring
articles.descEn: Mozilla is rolling out two updates to Smart Window, Firefox’s AI-powered browsing experience, allowing it to fill out forms based on the information in your open tabs.
articles.titleEn: Firefox’s Smart Window adds AI form filling and webpage monitoring
summaryLinesEn: Along with this update, you can now ask Firefox’s Smart Window to watch a certain webpage for sales, new job listings, and other updates.
Mozilla is updating Smart Window — Firefox’s AI-powered browsing experience — with a new feature that can help you fill out online forms based on your open tabs.
You can set up a task by typing “/watch” in the Smart Window chat, describing what you’re looking for, and adding the webpages you want to watch.

articles.title: Bank of America kindly asks that you don't share your banking password with your AI assistant
articles.descEn: The banking giant reminds customers that "you're responsible for activity" resulting from your AI agents' access.
articles.titleEn: Bank of America kindly asks that you don't share your banking password with your AI assistant
summaryLinesEn: In an email blast to customers titled “Protecting your finances in the Al World,” Bank of America urged customers to never share their username and password with another person or an outside service, “including an Al-enabled tool or agent that offers to act on your behalf.”

Sharing your banking username and password with an AI assistant runs the risk that it could do something with your finances without your knowledge, or that your bank thinks someone’s raiding your account and locks you out of it.

articles.title: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication
articles.descEn: A family is suing OpenAI, saying ChatGPT coached their daughter to quietly taper off her seizure medication and keep it from her doctors before she died in February.
articles.titleEn: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell Julie Bort Warhound raises $200M to engineer war dogs and arm them with Anduril gear Dominic-Madori Davis Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work Lucas Ropek
The suit joins a line of cases against OpenAI that include the August 2025 lawsuit brought by the parents of 16-year-old Adam Raine, which alleged OpenAI prioritized engagement over user safety .

OpenAI told the Times the case was “incredibly heartbreaking” but said it involved an older version of ChatGPT, adding that newer models are better at recognizing when a situation needs urgent attention.

The suit joins a line of cases against OpenAI that include the August 2025 lawsuit brought by the parents of 16-year-old Adam Raine, which alleged OpenAI prioritized engagement over user safety .

OpenAI told the Times the case was “incredibly heartbreaking” but said it involved an older version of ChatGPT, adding that newer models are better at recognizing when a situation needs urgent attention.

localization.title: 부모들은 GPT-4o가 딸에게 발작 약을 끊도록 지도했다고 주장하며 OpenAI를 고소함
summaryLines: Nvidia CEO는 사랑스러운 Microduck 로봇을 가지고 놀고, 20,000개 판매 Julie Bort Warhound는 군견을 설계하고 Anduril 장비로 무장하기 위해 2억 달러를 모금함 · Dominic-Madori Davis Uber는 30,000명의 직원 모두를 ChatGPT에 배치함 · 작업 Lucas Ropek
이 소송은 OpenAI가 사용자 안전보다 참여를 우선시한다고 주장하는 16세 Adam Raine의 부모가 제기한 2025년 8월 소송을 포함하여 OpenAI에 대한 일련의 소송에 합류함
OpenAI는 타임즈에 이 사건이 "엄청나게 가슴 아프다"고 말했지만 이 사건은 이전 버전의 ChatGPT와 관련이 있다고 말했으며 최신 모델은 긴급한 주의가 필요한 상황을 더 잘 인식할 수 있다고 덧붙였음

articles.descEn: KT가 AI 모델을 공급하고 사용량에 따라 요금을 받는 새로운 사업을 시작한다. 음성통화와 데이터 사용량을 측정해 과금하던 통신사업 방식을 AI 토큰 시장으로 확장하는 방식이다. KT가 구상한 토큰팩토리는 자체 데이터센터에서 토큰을 직접 생산하는 동시에 외부 AI 모델을 유통하고, 기업의 ...
articles.titleEn: AI 토큰도 통신처럼 판다...KT, 생산·유통 사업 진출
summaryLinesEn: 이 본부장은 “글로벌 AI 모델 중개 사업자들이 약 5%의 수수료를 받지만, KT는 이를 주력 수익원으로 삼지 않겠다”면서 “국내 데이터센터의 GPU에서 모델을 직접 운영해 토큰을 생산하고, 모델 공급사와 체결한 계약을 바탕으로 수익을 확보하겠다”고 말했다.
이진형 KT AX사업본부장은 글로벌 AI 모델 중개 플랫폼 오픈라우터의 통계를 인용해 최근 1년간 토큰 처리량이 35배 증가했다고 설명했다.
이 본부장은 AI를 이용해 로또 번호 분석 프로그램을 만드는 과정을 시연했는데, 역대 당첨번호를 분석하는 프로그램 제작에 약 3600만 토큰이 사용됐고, 비용은 약 15달러가 발생했다.

이 본부장은 AI를 이용해 로또 번호 분석 프로그램을 만드는 과정을 시연했는데, 역대 당첨번호를 분석하는 프로그램 제작에 약 3600만 토큰이 사용됐고, 비용은 약 15달러가 발생했다.

articles.title: HubSpot Faces Near-Term Pressure Amid Uneven Demand, Nascent AI Monetization, UBS Says
articles.descEn: HubSpot (HUBS) faces a bumpier near-term growth outlook amid uneven small and midsize business deman
articles.titleEn: HubSpot Faces Near-Term Pressure Amid Uneven Demand, Nascent AI Monetization, UBS Says
summaryLinesEn: HubSpot (HUBS) faces a bumpier near-term growth outlook amid uneven small and midsize business demand, early-stage artificial intelligence monetization and potential friction from its new pricing model, UBS Securities said in a note emailed Tuesday.
Insider Monkey • 1mo ago HUBS HubSpot Can Drive Durable Growth Amid Accelerating AI Adoption, RBC Says PREMIUM MT Newswires • 1mo ago HUBS HubSpot Stock Fell 11.3% in a Week.

The brokerage sees long-term upside from embedded AI and consumption-based monetization, but after a more than 30% share-price gain over the past month, HubSpot trades at about 12 times calendar 2027 enterprise value to free cash flow, leaving a balanced risk-reward outlook.

articles.title: How we're supporting better tropical cyclone prediction with AI
articles.descEn: We’re launching Weather Lab, featuring our experimental cyclone predictions, and we’re partnering with the U.S. National Hurricane Center to support their forecasts and warnings this cyclone season.
articles.titleEn: How we're supporting better tropical cyclone prediction with AI
summaryLinesEn: And in the past 50 years, they’ve caused $1.4 trillion in economic losses .
This could help experts and decision-makers better prepare for different scenarios, share news of risks involved and support decisions to manage a cyclone’s impact.

It’s trained to model two distinct types of data: a vast reanalysis dataset that reconstructs past weather over the entire Earth from millions of observations, and a specialized database containing key information about the track, intensity, size and wind radii of nearly 5,000 observed cyclones from the past 45 years.

summaryLines: 그리고 지난 50년 동안 그들은 1조 4천억 달러의 경제적 손실을 입혔음
이를 통해 전문가와 의사 결정자는 다양한 시나리오에 더 잘 대비하고, 관련된 위험에 대한 소식을 공유하며 사이클론의 영향을 관리하기 위한 결정을 지원할 수 있음
두 가지 유형의 데이터를 모델링하도록 훈련됨 · 하나는 수백만 건의 관측을 통해 지구 전체의 과거 날씨를 재구성하는 방대한 재분석 데이터 세트이고, 다른 하나는 지난 45년 동안 관측된 거의 5,000개의 사이클론의 경로, 강도, 크기 및 바람 반경에 대한 주요 정보가 포함된 특수 데이터베이스임

articles.title: BigQuery to Databricks: A Strategic Framework | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Discover best practices for migrating BigQuery data, scripts, and stacks to Databricks. Learn to optimize ROI and governance during your architectural evolution.
articles.titleEn: BigQuery to Databricks: A Strategic Framework | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Success depends on choosing the right entry point and managing the transition period effectively.
This guide outlines a migration framework across three pillars – Process, Technology, and People – for navigating that transition with minimal disruption and measurable business impact.
Profile the BigQuery estate first — datasets, query history and slot consumption — to find which workloads drive cost, which dashboards are actually used, and which tables are never queried at all.

articles.title: Abridge October 2026 Release: Visit Topics, Evaluation Dashboard, & More
articles.descEn: Abridge's October release saves clinicians time, meets CDI and revenue cycle needs in the note, and shows partners how we evaluate our clinical AI.
articles.titleEn: Abridge October 2026 Release: Visit Topics, Evaluation Dashboard, & More
summaryLinesEn: Conditions due for follow-up are in view before the visit starts, orders are staged before the patient leaves, and inpatient notes start from what the chart already holds.

This month, Visit Topics, In-Visit Orders, and Patient Visit Summary Editing with the Abridge Assistant help transform how clinicians prepare for a visit, capture orders throughout the conversation, and send patients home with a summary more easily tailored to them.

Much of the work that makes a visit or a hospital stay take longer than it should is reconstruction: keeping track of which conditions still need follow-up, entering orders after the patient has left, assembling an admission note from across the chart.

articles.title: Apple unveils new iMac with M6
articles.descEn: Apple today announced the new iMac featuring the superfast M6, delivering even more performance and powerful AI capabilities.
articles.titleEn: Apple unveils new iMac with M6
summaryLinesEn: It will begin arriving to customers, and in Apple Store locations and Apple Authorized Resellers, starting Friday, November 6. iMac with M6 featuring a 10-core CPU and 10-core GPU starts at $1,499 (U.S.) and $1,449 (U.S.) with education savings . iMac with a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU starts at $1,699 (U.S.) and $1,599 (U.S.) with education savings .

Industry-leading camera and audio : A 12MP Center Stage camera helps keep users perfectly framed on video calls, while Desk View enables them to share a top-down view of their workspace — ideal for educators giving lessons or creatives showing off their latest project. iMac also brings incredible audio to any space.

Up to 2.5x faster performance in apps like Microsoft Excel, compared to iMac with M1, 1 and up to 1.5x faster performance than M4, so families, aspiring creators, and small businesses can fly through daily productivity tasks.

articles.title: How AI Is Changing the Pace of Discovery for Millions Living With Dementia
articles.descEn: The Consortium for Biomedical Research and AI in Neurodegeneration is working with NVIDIA to deploy open source AI tools to accelerate the science that makes new treatments possible.
articles.titleEn: How AI Is Changing the Pace of Discovery for Millions Living With Dementia
summaryLinesEn: There are 57 million people worldwide living with dementia today.

To explore how AI and accelerated computing can advance Alzheimer’s research while navigating its technical demands, C-BRAIN is working with NVIDIA to incorporate technologies including the NVIDIA BioNeMo open developer platform and the MONAI framework for C-BRAIN’s research pipelines.
The bottlenecks are not enough high impact scientific findings, too much data living in institutional silos and too slow a pace of synthesis to keep up with the research that is published.

localization.title: AI가 치매를 앓고 있는 수백만 명의 발견 속도를 어떻게 변화시키는가
summaryLines: 오늘날 전 세계적으로 5,700만 명이 치매를 앓고 있음
C-BRAIN은 AI와 가속 컴퓨팅이 알츠하이머 연구를 발전시키는 동시에 기술적 요구 사항을 충족할 수 있는 방법을 탐색하기 위해 NVIDIA와 협력하여 C-BRAIN의 연구 파이프라인을 위한 NVIDIA BioNeMo 개방형 개발자 플랫폼 및 MONAI 프레임워크를 포함한 기술을 통합하고 있음
병목 현상은 영향력이 큰 과학적 연구 결과가 충분하지 않고, 기관의 사일로에 너무 많은 데이터가 존재하며, 발표된 연구를 따라잡기에는 너무 느린 합성 속도로 인해 발생함

articles.title: WRITER Gives Enterprises Control Over AI Detection with Invisible, Customer-Specific Watermarks
articles.descEn: WRITER’s watermarking approach builds on its commitment to put enterprises in control of their AI decisions and outputs
articles.titleEn: WRITER Gives Enterprises Control Over AI Detection with Invisible, Customer-Specific Watermarks
summaryLinesEn: They want ownership, control, and configurability, right down to how and when their AI-generated content is watermarked,” said May Habib, CEO and Co-founder of WRITER.

WRITER’s watermarking approach builds on its commitment to put enterprises in control of their AI decisions and outputs SAN FRANCISCO — October 27, 2026 — WRITER , the leading AI platform for enterprise growth, today introduced a new approach to text watermarking that gives enterprises ownership, control and choice over how their AI-generated text is identified and traced.
When enterprises enable watermarking, text generated by WRITER’s Palmyra models will carry an invisible, machine-readable mark specific to each customer’s organization.

articles.title: What We Know About Eligible Voters Who Are Naturalized U.S. Citizens
articles.descEn: Around one-in-ten eligible voters in this year's midterms are naturalized citizens. See where they live, where they're from and how they differ demographically.
articles.titleEn: What We Know About Eligible Voters Who Are Naturalized U.S. Citizens
summaryLinesEn: In 2000, approximately 12 million people – about 6.2% of all eligible voters that year – were naturalized citizens.
But the Philippines has since surpassed India and China to become the second-most common country of origin for eligible voters who are naturalized citizens.

This Pew Research Center analysis provides key facts about eligible voters who are naturalized citizens – that is, immigrants to the United States who gained citizenship through naturalization and are eligible to vote because they are at least 18 years old.

sourceContent.headline: What We Know About Eligible Voters Who Are Naturalized U.S. Citizens
sourceContent.description: Around one-in-ten eligible voters in this year's midterms are naturalized citizens. See where they live, where they're from and how they differ demographically.
paragraphs: In 2000, approximately 12 million people – about 6.2% of all eligible voters that year – were naturalized citizens.
But the Philippines has since surpassed India and China to become the second-most common country of origin for eligible voters who are naturalized citizens.

This Pew Research Center analysis provides key facts about eligible voters who are naturalized citizens – that is, immigrants to the United States who gained citizenship through naturalization and are eligible to vote because they are at least 18 years old.

An estimated 250 million people in the United States are eligible to vote in this year’s midterm elections . Around one-in-ten of them – or 25 million – are naturalized citizens, according to a Pew Research Center analysis of U.S. Census Bureau data.

Naturalized citizens are people who were born outside the U.S. and gained American citizenship through naturalization. They are generally eligible to vote if they are at least 18 years old, as is the case with people born in the U.S. and those born abroad to American parents.

The number of naturalized citizens who are eligible to vote more than doubled from 2000 to 2024 (the most recent year for which data is available). That is much larger than the increase in the total eligible voter population during that time period. In 2000, approximately 12 million people – about 6.2% of all eligible voters that year – were naturalized citizens.

articles.title: Can we trust LLMs to judge whether a research idea is novel?
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Can we trust LLMs to judge whether a research idea is novel?
summaryLinesEn: By comparison, Idea Novelty Checker, a literature-grounded retrieval and reranking pipeline, scored 0.642 at $30.66, while Sakana AI’s AI Scientist, whose novelty evaluator iteratively searches Semantic Scholar, scored 0.772 at $82.05.
We saw substantial shifts on the Human-Only dataset as well; the same change moved Claude Opus 4.6 accuracy by 21 points.
On the Human+Generated set, a simple Claude Opus 4.6 prompt using low reasoning and majority voting across three calls achieved 0.854 macro-F1 at a total evaluation cost of $2.59.

articles.title: Exowatt beats frontier models on accuracy with SageMaker serverless model customization | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: In this post, we show how Exowatt used Amazon SageMaker AI serverless model customization to build a repeatable AI pipeline that produces task-specific fine-tuned models for two deployment targets, edge and cloud, achieving higher accuracy than frontier models at up to 49x lower cost.
articles.titleEn: Exowatt beats frontier models on accuracy with SageMaker serverless model customization | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Training completed in about 32 minutes on SageMaker serverless fine-tuning for roughly $20–$25.
They then expanded the training set to 86,281 rows by having Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 4.6 on Amazon Bedrock rewrite the prose of each example while its labels and numeric fields stayed fixed.
The pipeline produces task-specific fine-tuned models for two deployment targets, edge and cloud, achieving higher accuracy than frontier models at up to 49× lower cost.

articles.title: Fix evaluation bias to unlock better models on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Property Finder found that 96.8% of their vision-AI evaluation labels were inherited from the incumbent model, hiding its true accuracy. See how they built unbiased ground truth, applied evolutionary prompt optimization, and selected a more accurate, cost-effective model on Amazon Bedrock, cutting cost by 86% across 11 image-quality attributes.
articles.titleEn: Fix evaluation bias to unlock better models on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The engineering team at Property Finder , a digital real estate application, discovered that 96.8 percent of their evaluation labels had been inherited directly from a single model’s predictions rather than verified by human experts.
In the remaining 3.2 percent of human-labeled samples, annotators had introduced categories outside the original specification, like Office appearing where no such label existed in the prompt.

In this post, we share how Property Finder identified evaluation bias, built unbiased ground truth, and applied evolutionary prompt optimization to select the right model on Amazon Bedrock, achieving higher accuracy at 86 percent lower cost.
articles.summary:
The engineering team at Property Finder , a digital real estate application, discovered that 96.8 percent of their evaluation labels had been inherited directly from a single model’s predictions rather than verified by human experts.
In the remaining 3.2 percent of human-labeled samples, annotators had introduced categories outside the original specification, like Office appearing where no such label existed in the prompt.
In this post, we share how Property Finder identified evaluation bias, built unbiased ground truth, and applied evolutionary prompt optimization to select the right model on Amazon Bedrock, achieving higher accuracy at 86 percent lower cost.

localization.title: Amazon Bedrock에서 더 나은 모델을 잠금 해제하기 위해 평가 편향 수정 | 아마존 웹 서비스
summaryLines: 디지털 부동산 애플리케이션인 Property Finder의 엔지니어링 팀은 평가 라벨의 96.8%가 인간 전문가의 검증이 아닌 단일 모델의 예측에서 직접 상속되었다는 사실을 발견함
사람이 레이블을 지정한 나머지 3.2%의 샘플에서는 주석 작성자가 프롬프트에 해당 레이블이 없는 곳에 Office가 나타나는 것과 같이 원래 사양을 벗어난 범주를 도입함
이 게시물에서는 Property Finder가 어떻게 평가 편향을 식별하고, 편향되지 않은 실측 정보를 구축하고, 혁신적인 프롬프트 최적화를 적용하여 Amazon Bedrock에서 올바른 모델을 선택하여 86% 더 낮은 비용으로 더 높은 정확도를 달성했는지 공유함

articles.title: Announcing SOCI-indexed images for faster SageMaker AI jobs | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Seekable OCI (SOCI) indexing for Amazon SageMaker AI training and processing jobs takes full container image download off the critical path. SageMaker AI lazy-loads your image to start containers in seconds instead of minutes, with no changes to your job definition. See the benchmarks and how to adopt it.
articles.titleEn: Announcing SOCI-indexed images for faster SageMaker AI jobs | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: As we show in the What we measured section, this reduced GPU idle time during image pulls by up to 90 percent in our benchmarks.
SOCI-indexed images start Amazon SageMaker AI training containers in seconds, with no impact on training performance.

The impact is largest exactly where iteration speed matters most: hyperparameter tuning sweeps for hundreds of jobs, quick experiments, and short processing jobs, where image download can dominate total runtime.

articles.descEn: A Blog post by Liquid AI on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Build specialized multimodal models with LFM3
summaryLinesEn: On audio-visual video understanding, it beats models up to 10.7B parameters, such as Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, on Daily-Omni, WorldSense, and AV-SpeakerBench.
To run LFM3-1.7B, install the latest version of transformers : Reach for LFM3-VL-2B when you need on-device visual understanding.

Built for the edge: the text model fits in about 1 GB at 4-bit precision, new in-house vision and audio encoders speed up processing, and the text model’s 256K context window lets agents run on-device.

articles.title: Unlocking Investment Insights Without Migrating Your Data: Lakehouse Federation | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Use Databricks Lakehouse Federation to join on-premise portfolio data with FactSet marketplace data powering a dashboard and Genie. Join on-premises portfolio data with FactSet cloud analytics in a single SQL query with no pipelines, no copies, no compliance headaches. Build Dashboards and Agents on this enriched data.
articles.titleEn: Unlocking Investment Insights Without Migrating Your Data: Lakehouse Federation | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: One query, full picture: A single SQL join across both catalogs powers dashboards and Genie natural-language queries, with zero persisted intermediate objects providing rich portfolio and investment information.
That challenge is compounded by the fact that the third-party data they need for analysis, including market data, analyst estimates, and financial fundamentals increasingly lives in the cloud.
Traditional approaches force an uncomfortable choice: copy sensitive data to the cloud, stand up brittle ETL pipelines, or give up on integrating the two altogether.

articles.title: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
articles.descEn: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.
articles.titleEn: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
summaryLinesEn: Weekly Claude for Government active users are up about eightfold since February, and usage across federal civilian agencies has grown about 20-fold in a year.
A US state IT developer moved nearly 900 API methods to a new framework in two days.
We are also launching a dedicated program to help agencies implement and make the most of their Claude use.

articles.descEn: Over the past few months, we’ve used an unreleased, internal research model to find critical vulnerabilities in some of the world’s most widely used software, such as browsers and operating systems. articles.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
articles.descEn: Genie 4 introduces real-time interactive world simulation with native audio, advanced physics, natural human motion, and steering powered by Gemini models.
articles.titleEn: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
summaryLinesEn: We have started rolling Genie 4 out as a research preview for trusted testers — gathering feedback before we release it to consumers and developers, starting with Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early access partners of the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.

The Genie 4 model incorporates and builds on capabilities from the Gemini family: Gemini Omni anchors the simulations in real-world appearance and behavior, while other Gemini models provide the complex reasoning needed to help maintain a simulation’s coherence and continuity.
Today, we are announcing Genie 4, our new world model, which unlocks unprecedented realism and improves real-time interactive simulation.

articles.title: Early progress on accelerating drug development with Claude
articles.descEn: Over the past several months, we’ve partnered with six organizations to accelerate curing disease. We’ve also started drug discovery efforts of our own, including programs for rare childhood forms of muscular dystrophy. In this post, we provide an update on our progress.
articles.titleEn: Early progress on accelerating drug development with Claude
summaryLinesEn: BMS is using Claude to assess plans of an early-stage drug in clinical trials, and to estimate the likelihood of those trials succeeding.

We’ve also recently launched an open call for guest investigators in the life sciences; we’re seeking proposals from research groups who want to use Claude to investigate key questions in drug discovery and other areas.
If Claude is to significantly increase the rate of new cures, we need to work with many more biotechnology firms and integrate Claude more deeply into their development processes.

articles.title: 哪款 Pro Max 手機符合需求？
articles.descEn: 評估 Pro Max 是否值得：比較 Find X10 系列的適用性、實際取捨，以及在台灣購買前應確認的證據。
articles.titleEn: 哪款 Pro Max 手機符合需求？
summaryLinesEn: OPPO 測試指出，相較前一代原色真彩鏡頭，感光能力提升 43%；實際成果可能因場景及軟體版本而異。
重量參考依地區而異：歐洲版 226–228 公克、非歐洲版 233–235 公克，台灣版本尚未確認。

articles.title: 哪款旗艦手機的標準版符合需求？
articles.descEn: 標準版旗艦價值指南：比較 Find X10 系列是否符合需求、實際取捨，以及在台灣購買前應確認的資訊。
articles.titleEn: 哪款旗艦手機的標準版符合需求？
summaryLinesEn: 數據包含最高全域峰值 2000 尼特、局部峰值 3600 尼特、最低 1 尼特、P3 色域與 95% BT.2020 涵蓋率。
標準版 Find X10 不必具備所有 Pro Max 功能，也可能滿足旗艦需求：它配備 2 億畫素主鏡頭與長焦、6.59 吋螢幕、天璣 9600M 及 ColorOS 17。
Pro Max 在 2 億畫素主鏡頭與長焦之外，增加 2 億畫素超廣角，並列出更大的 6.78 吋螢幕、天璣 9600 Pro，以及機型專屬的 17EV 電影級高動態範圍錄影。

articles.title: Newsom agrees smart glasses need privacy rules—just not the ones California lawmakers wrote | Fortune
articles.descEn: Newsom rejected new recording safeguards as too broad, even as he acknowledged the privacy risks posed by wearable cameras.
articles.titleEn: Newsom agrees smart glasses need privacy rules—just not the ones California lawmakers wrote | Fortune
summaryLinesEn: And for smart-glasses heavyweight Meta, sales topped 7 million pairs last year , according to eyewear partner EssilorLuxottica .
Meanwhile, tech companies are working to make smart glasses a familiar sight—even Iron Man has been recruited to help.

As Thorin Klosowski, a security and privacy activist at the Electronic Frontier Foundation, previously told Fortune , “I hope that there is not just a general giving up toward the inevitability of everyone having a camera strapped on their face all the time.”

articles.titleEn: QuestMobile 2026 Panoramic Ecosystem Traffic Autumn Report – Full Mobile User Behavior Insights & Industry Traffic Trend Analysis
summaryLinesEn: According to QuestMobile data, as of August 2026, the monthly active user scale of China's mobile internet has reached 1.278 billion, with a slight year-on-year increase of 0.9%.

The industry has shifted from device volume growth to ecological collaborative operation, and ecological linkage has promoted continuous differentiation of active performance of various brands According to QuestMobile data, in August 2026, the number of active smart TV terminal devices has reached 300 million, with a net increase of 11.882 million units compared with the same period last year.

With the rise of AI applications, the ecological traffic model of the mobile internet has expanded from the previous APP-dominated, multi-terminal concurrent and offline penetration pattern to multi-scenario and full-link closed loop, thus forming a "panoramic ecological model centered on users, driven by AI, anchored by intent recognition, featuring cross-terminal continuity and cross-scenario delivery".

summaryLines: QuestMobile 데이터에 따르면 2026년 8월 현재 중국 모바일 인터넷의 월간 활성 사용자 규모는 12억 7,800만 명에 달해 전년 대비 0.9% 소폭 증가함

articles.title: How AI agents shape experts’ judgment calls
articles.descEn: In a randomized trial, professional analysts working with an AI coding agent went with the option the agent was randomly assigned to favor 86% of the time. We look at what this means for human oversight of AI-assisted work.
articles.titleEn: How AI agents shape experts’ judgment calls
summaryLinesEn: On each of the four analytical decisions, analysts’ choices matched their agents’ lean the large majority of the time: 92% for the outcome measure, 82% for the comparison method, 81% for which farms the estimate covered, and 90% for weighting.
Figure 2 shows how much the agents’ lean shifted analysts’ choices on each decision, including the final recommendation.
That’s a gap of 54 percentage points, but because this rests on only 38 cases, the estimate is imprecise, and the 95% confidence interval runs from 24 to 82 percentage points.

articles.title: I Tested Every Major AI Agent for a Day. Here’s the Best One
articles.descEn: I ranked six AI agents—from Meta’s Muse to Anthropic’s Claude Duet—on how well they completed basic tasks.
articles.titleEn: I Tested Every Major AI Agent for a Day. Here’s the Best One
summaryLinesEn: Google’s Gemini Spark is a beta inside the Gemini app and costs $20 a month. xAI’s Grok Bot costs $30 a month and is in its own app .
Before I started the test, I created a Google Calendar event for 2 pm, labeling it as an important source meeting that can’t be moved.

I also sent an email from my work account to my personal account, with the made-up scenario that my mom was getting out of the hospital today, and I needed to call her at 2 pm to send love and support from afar.

articles.titleEn: HP and Asus shift some PC making back to China due to AI-driven cost hikes
summaryLinesEn: (Illustration by Michael Tsang) Emerging contract manufacturers reap benefits of supply-chain strategy reversal TAIPEI -- Leading PC makers, including HP of the U.S. and Asus and Acer of Taiwan, are combating soaring component costs by shifting some production from Thailand and Vietnam back to China and using a new generation of contract manufacturers.
HP and Asus are among PC makers returning some production to China after building facilities in Vietnam and Thailand as part of a "China+1" diversification strategy.
